pick_bridge_v0: pick the bridge passage title between two candidates using answer presence and link structure
normalize_answer: normalize an answer string by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
add_sp_labels: add sentence-level supervision labels to retrieved HotpotQA results using original supporting facts

explore_QDMR: explore question decomposition data from the BREAK dataset and align it with HotpotQA entries
